long_biography.plain_text:
Peter Allen Giacalone combined finance with field operations long before moving into ownership. After serving as a vice-president of finance at News Corporation, he became DIRECTV's executive vice-president for customer satisfaction, overseeing home services, call centres and supply-chain operations. He then led 180 Connect as president and chief executive through its sale to DIRECTV, before serving as president and executive chairman of UniTek Global Services.

At ITG, Giacalone helped shape a contractor serving broadband networks and other utility infrastructure across the United States. He directed overall strategy as executive chairman from the company's early years until retiring from that post in April 2026. The company's public-market debut preserved his involvement as a director. An Adelphi University graduate with bachelor's and MBA degrees, he also contributes as a guest lecturer in its Executive in Residence programme.
